grammar.title: This is / These are
grammar.explain_en: We use 'This is' for one person. We use 'These are' for more than one person.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'This is' để giới thiệu một người. Chúng ta dùng 'These are' để giới thiệu nhiều người.

grammar.title: He / She / They
grammar.explain_en: We use 'He' for a boy or a man. We use 'She' for a girl or a woman. We use 'They' for more than one person.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'He' cho con trai hoặc đàn ông. Chúng ta dùng 'She' cho con gái hoặc phụ nữ. Chúng ta dùng 'They' cho nhiều người.
examples: This is my father. He is tall.
This is my mother. She is kind.
These are my parents. They are happy.

grammar.title: Possessive 's
grammar.explain_en: We use 's to show that something belongs to someone or is related to someone.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 's để chỉ sự sở hữu hoặc mối quan hệ của ai đó.

grammar.title: I love / He loves
grammar.explain_en: We use 'love' with I, you, we, they. We use 'loves' with he, she, it.
grammar.explain_vi: Chúng ta dùng 'love' với I, you, we, they. Chúng ta dùng 'loves' với he, she, it.

song.tune: Sing to the tune of 'The Wheels on the Bus'
lines: My family is happy, yes it is,
Yes it is, yes it is.
My family is happy, yes it is,
My mother is kind, yes she is,
Yes she is, yes she is.

song.actions_vi:
Gợi ý động tác khi hát: 
- 'My family is happy': Đặt tay lên tim và mỉm cười.
- 'My mother is kind': Đặt tay lên tim, sau đó giơ ngón cái lên.
- 'My father is strong': Gồng cơ bắp tay.
- 'I love my family/mother/father!': Khoanh tay ôm mình.

readings.title: MY FAMILY
readings.text: Hello! My name is Linh. I am seven years old. I have a family. My family is small. I have a mother and a father. My mother's name is Mai. She is kind. My father's name is Nam. He is tall. I love my mother and father. We are a happy family. I love my family very much.
readings.image_prompt: A happy Vietnamese girl, Linh, smiling and pointing to a picture frame with her mother and father in it. They are in a simple, cozy living room. No text.
questions: Is her family big or small?

readings.title: BEN'S BIG FAMILY
readings.text: Hi! I am Ben. I am seven years old. I have a big family. I have a mother and a father. My mother is Ms. Hoa. She is kind and lovely. My father is Mr. Hai. He is strong and happy. I also have a big brother. His name is Tom. He is ten years old. Tom is good at playing football. We play together. I have a baby sister, too. Her name is Lucy. She is one year old. Lucy is very cute. I love my big family. We are always happy together.
readings.image_prompt: A happy, diverse family (parents, two sons, baby daughter) playing in a park, laughing and kicking a football. The older boy is helping the younger boy kick the ball. No text.
questions: Does Ben have a big or small family?

readings.title: MY WONDERFUL GRANDPARENTS
readings.text: My name is Minh. I am seven. I live with my parents, my little sister, and my grandparents. My grandmother's name is Lan. She is very kind. She tells me many stories. My grandfather's name is Hung. He is strong and wise. He helps me with my homework. My little sister, An, loves to draw. She is five years old. My parents work hard. My mother is a doctor. My father is an engineer. They are busy, but they always spend time with us. On Sundays, we all go to the park. We play games and eat ice cream. My family is wonderful. We love each other very much. I am happy to have my grandparents with us.
readings.image_prompt: A diverse family (grandparents, parents, boy, girl) happily spending time together in a park. The grandfather is helping the boy with a book, the grandmother is telling a story to the girl, and the parents are smiling watching them. They are eating ice cream. No text.

odd_one_out.why_vi: Teacher (giáo viên) không phải là thành viên trong gia đình.
Sad (buồn) là cảm xúc tiêu cực, không giống happy, kind, love (tích cực).
Read (đọc) là động từ, còn lại là tính từ chỉ kích thước.
School (trường học) là một địa điểm, còn lại là thành viên trong gia đình.
Dog (chó) là động vật, còn lại là tên người.

life_skill.title: LOVE AND CARE FOR YOUR FAMILY
life_skill.intro: Your family is special! They love you and care for you. It's important to show your love and care back.
life_skill.intro_vi: Gia đình em rất đặc biệt! Họ yêu thương và quan tâm em. Điều quan trọng là em cũng phải thể hiện tình yêu và sự quan tâm của mình dành cho họ.
life_skill.value_question: What is one thing you can do today to show love to your family?
life_skill.image_prompt: A diverse family (parents, two children, grandparents) doing various acts of kindness and love: one child is helping set the table, another is hugging a grandparent, a parent is reading to a child. All are smiling. No text.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Not all families are the same size. Some families are very big, and some are small!
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Không phải tất cả các gia đình đều có cùng kích thước. Một số gia đình rất đông người, và một số thì ít người!

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Many animals live in families too, just like us! For example, lions live in groups called 'prides'.
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Nhiều loài động vật cũng sống theo gia đình, giống như chúng ta! Ví dụ, sư tử sống theo nhóm gọi là 'bầy đàn'.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? In some cultures, grandparents often live with their children and grandchildren, creating big, happy homes.
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Ở một số nền văn hóa, ông bà thường sống cùng con cái và cháu chắt, tạo nên những ngôi nhà lớn, hạnh phúc.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? The word 'family' comes from a very old Latin word 'familia'.
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Từ 'family' (gia đình) có nguồn gốc từ một từ Latin cổ là 'familia'.

fun_facts.en: Did you know? Family photos are a great way to remember happy times and the people you love!
fun_facts.vi: Em có biết không? Ảnh gia đình là một cách tuyệt vời để ghi nhớ những khoảnh khắc hạnh phúc và những người em yêu thương!

classroom_game.name: Family Member Memory Match
steps_en: Teacher prepares cards with family member words (mother, father, brother, sister, etc.) and matching pictures.
Shuffle all cards and place them face down on the table.
Players take turns flipping two cards. If the word and picture match, the player keeps the pair.
If they don't match, flip them back over. The player with the most pairs at the end wins.
steps_vi: Giáo viên chuẩn bị các thẻ bài có từ vựng về thành viên gia đình (mother, father, brother, sister,...) và các hình ảnh tương ứng.
Trộn tất cả các thẻ và đặt úp xuống bàn.
Người chơi lần lượt lật hai thẻ. Nếu từ và hình ảnh khớp nhau, người chơi giữ cặp thẻ đó.
Nếu không khớp, lật úp lại. Người chơi có nhiều cặp thẻ nhất sẽ thắng.

message_body:
Dear Roxy English learner,
Your family is a precious gift. They are always there for you, full of love and support. Remember to show your love and appreciation every day. Keep learning and growing with your wonderful family!
value_line: Learn English – Learn to Love – Learn to Grow.
edits: Fixed IPA for father, mother, brother, sister, grandfather, and grandmother for standard American English pronunciation.
Corrected grandfather/grandmother names in Reading 3 (Lan/Hung) to avoid naming them 'Ba' and 'Ong', which are titles.
Updated Reading 3 question 'What does his grandmother do?' to 'What does his grandmother tell him?' for better alignment with the text.
Fixed duplicate keys in Review.complete_words (differentiating grandmother and grandfather).
Changed 'short' emoji from a tree (which is usually tall) to a small plant (herb/shrub) for better visual logic.
Changed 'parent' emoji to a family representation for better clarity.
